job.title: Human Resources Business Partner
job.jdText: Human Business Partner â Remote Reports To: Senior Director of Human Resources Cardiovascular Services of America (CVAUSA) is the largest private and independent cardiology network in the United States. Our inclusive and diverse network brings together top cardiovascular specialists and thought leaders who offer regional perspectives and a broad strategic vision for the future of patient care. Who We are and what we do: Â Â Headquartered in Orlando area, Cardiovascular Associates of America aims to bring the best cardiovascular physicians in one network with the common mission of saving lives, reducing costs, and improving patient care through clinical innovation. Through CVAUSAâs physician-centered practice management model, physicians drive clinical care and their practice culture, while benefiting from the business expertise and shared resources available through CVAUSA for better patient outcomes. Position Summary The Human Resources Manager serves as a trusted HR partner supporting the National Services Organization (NSO) and a network of independent physician practices in a multi-site healthcare environment. Reporting to the Senior Director of Human Resources, this role is responsible for providing practical HR guidance with a strong focus on employee relations, talent acquisition, and leadership support while ensuring consistent HR practices across a growing organization. This position is ideal for an experienced HR professional who enjoys balancing strategic partnership with hands-on execution. The HR Manager works closely with physicians, practice administrators, operational leaders, and corporate stakeholders to address employee concerns, support organizational growth, recruit top talent, and foster positive workplace cultures while respecting the unique identity of each practice. Success in this role requires sound judgment, exceptional relationship-building skills, strong business acumen, and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, evolving organization. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Employee Relations & HR Partnership Â Serve as the primary HR partner to assigned business leaders, physicians, and practice administrators, providing practical guidance on employee relations, performance management, organizational policies, and HR best practices. Handle employee relations matters from initial intake through resolution, including conducting workplace investigations, documenting findings, and recommending appropriate corrective actions. Coach leaders through difficult conversations, performance concerns, conflict resolution, employee engagement, and policy interpretation. Balance employee advocacy with sound business judgment while minimizing organizational risk. Identify employee relations trends and recommend proactive solutions to strengthen leadership effectiveness, improve retention, and enhance workplace culture. Build trusted relationships with leaders across multiple locations while supporting the unique culture of each independent practice. Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning Partner with hiring managers to identify staffing needs and develop recruiting strategies for clinical, administrative, and corporate positions. Manage full-cycle recruitment including sourcing, screening, interviewing, offer coordination, and hiring. Collaborate with recruiting resources and hiring leaders to improve candidate experience and reduce time-to-fill. Coordinate and support onboarding to ensure new employees successfully integrate into both the organization and their individual practice culture. Assist leadership with workforce planning to support organizational growth, expansion, and acquisitions. HR Operations & Organizational Support Provide day-to-day HR support to assigned practices and NSO leaders. Support organizational growth initiatives, including onboarding new practices and assisting with HR integration efforts. Assist in developing scalable HR policies, procedures, and best practices that support a decentralized operating model. Partner with Payroll, Benefits, HRIS, Compliance, and Operations to ensure a consistent and positive employee experience. Ensure compliance with applicable federal, state, and local employment laws, company policies, and regulatory requirements. Leadership & Organizational Effectiveness Build credibility and trusted partnerships with leaders at all levels of the organization. Support organizational change initiatives through effective communication, coaching, and employee support. Use data, sound judgment, and business insight to help leaders make informed workforce decisions. Participate in HR initiatives that improve employee engagement, retention, leadership capability, and operational effectiveness. Travel Travel up to 20% to partner practices and regional locations to provide on-site HR support, conduct investigations, facilitate training, and strengthen relationships with practice leadership. Qualifications Education Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, or a related field required. Experience 5+ years of progressive Human Resources experience. Experience supporting multiple locations or business units preferred. Previous experience in healthcare, physician practice management, National Services Organizations (NSOs), or similarly complex environments is strongly preferred. Demonstrated experience managing employee relations matters and conducting workplace investigations. Hands-on full-cycle recruiting experience required. Preferred Certifications SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, or SPHR certification preferred. Knowledge, Skills & Abilities The ideal candidate will: Â Demonstrate strong expertise in employee relations and conflict resolution. Think strategically while remaining willing to execute day-to-day HR responsibilities. Build strong relationships and credibility with leaders across the organization. Effectively coach managers on performance management, employee development, and workplace concerns. Possess strong recruiting skills with the ability to identify and attract high-quality talent. Thrive in a fast-paced, growing environment where priorities evolve quickly. Exercise sound judgment, discretion, and professionalism when handling confidential information. Demonstrate exceptional communication, organization, and problem-solving skills. Successfully manage multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail. Working Conditions Work is primarily performed in a professional office or remote office environment free from excessive noise and distractions. Work area must ensure confidentiality of employee and organizational information. Regular use of computers, telephones, and standard office equipment. Physical Requirements Ability to sit, stand, walk, bend, and move throughout the workday. Frequent use of hands and fingers for keyboarding and other office tasks. Ability to communicate effectively through speaking, listening, and reading. Occasional reaching, stooping, kneeling, or crouching. Ability to lift, push, pull, or move up to 10 pounds on an occasional basis. Equal Employment Opportunity We are an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued and respected. We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to fostering an environment that promotes equity, inclusion, and belonging. job.title: Administrative Data Entry File Clerk
job.jdText: Dedicated to delivering exceptional service and maintaining organized business operations, our company is seeking a detail-oriented Administrative Data Entry File Clerk to join our team. If you excel at managing records, entering data accurately, and working independently in a remote environment, this opportunity may be the perfect fit for you. In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining digital files, updating databases, organizing administrative records, and ensuring information is entered accurately and efficiently. Your attention to detail, reliability, and commitment to data accuracy will play an important role in supporting daily operations and helping our team stay organized and productive. Â Key responsibilities: Â Intake & indexing. Receive files from shared inboxes, portals, internal ticketing tools, and cloud folders. Confirm document type, required fields, signatures, and attachments. Index each record using standard metadata (client/project ID, date, document category, version, region). Â Document organization. Apply standardized naming conventions and folder structures. Convert formats when needed (PDF merge/split, image-to-PDF, compressing, version labeling). Maintain controlled libraries (final vs draft vs archived), including retention tags. Â Quality control Perform daily spot checks for duplicates, misfiles, missing pages, and unreadable scans. Flag exceptions and route them to the correct owner with clear notes. Maintain error logs and contribute to process improvements that reduce rework. Â Records governance & compliance Handle sensitive records with strict access controls and confidentiality. Follow retention schedules, legal hold instructions, and deletion/archival rules. Support audits by pulling records quickly and documenting chain-of-custody steps. Â Collaboration & communication. Coordinate with HR, Finance, Operations, Legal, or Customer teams to clarify file requirements. Provide status updates on backlog, turnaround time, and issues found during processing. Â Tools you may use: Â Cloud storage (Google Drive/SharePoint/Dropbox), document tools (Adobe Acrobat or equivalents), spreadsheets, ticketing (Jira/Asana/ServiceNow), e-signature platforms, and basic office productivity tools. Success metrics (examples): Accuracy rate (misfile/metadata error rate) Turnaround time from receipt to filed Backlog size and daily throughput Audit retrieval speed and completeness Compliance adherence (access control, retention tagging) Â Qualifications: Â Experience in records management, admin support, clerical work, or document control (preferred). Strong attention to detail; able to follow naming/filing rules consistently. Comfortable handling confidential information and following strict procedures. Basic computer proficiency: file systems, spreadsheets, PDFs, and collaboration tools. job.title: Marketing Assistant
job.jdText: Venture Media is a full-service content marketing agency. We help businesses grow through social media, podcast production, SEO and AI visibility, and full-funnel content systems. We are a small, fast-moving remote team that ships real client work every week. The role We are looking for a Marketing Assistant to support content production and daily execution across our client accounts and internal brands. You will keep the content engine running: scheduling posts, prepping assets, and running research. Your job will be across assistant and marketing work, so you should like variety. Marketing expertise is a plus for this role, but it is not required. What matters most is having a basic understanding of marketing and a genuine desire to learn and develop deeper expertise. We use automation and clear systems for the heavy lifting, so your job is less about busywork and more about keeping things organized, checking quality, and helping our content and clients look great. You will work directly with the founder and learn how a modern agency runs end to end. What you will do Content coordination and publishing. Schedule and publish blogs and posts, keep our content calendar organized, and make sure everything goes out on time. Much of the writing is already automated, so your role is organizing, reviewing, and adding the final human touch. Quality control. Do a first pass on assets from our editors, proofread copy and decks before they go to clients, and make sure feedback actually gets addressed. Research and reporting. Run market research for projects as needed, and help pull simple analytics reports so we know what is working. Social and community support. Help manage engagement and distribution across our platforms, and keep our own brand active and consistent. Light marketing execution. Learn the basics of SEO and AI search visibility, and help apply them to our content. We will teach you this piece by piece. General right-hand work. Jump on whatever the day needs. Some days that is research, some days it is organizing a project in our task tools, some days it is prepping something for a client. What we are looking for Bachelor's in a related field or equivalent hands-on experience 1 to 2 years in a marketing, social media, communications, or administrative role, ideally at an agency  Extremely organized and proactive, able to juggle multiple priorities and stay detailed under deadline Comfortable with the major social platforms (Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube) and scheduling tools Familiar with project management software A reliable communicator who keeps managers updated and follows through without being chased A flexible team player who adapts to shifting priorities and jumps in where needed Clear written English and comfort in an async remote setup Available during US Pacific business hours so we can work in real time Dedicated to this as your main full-time focus, not a side gig Nice to have (not required) SEO or AI search visibility experience Experience with task managers like ClickUp Who this is not for This is not a fit if you need constant hand-holding, avoid feedback, or prefer slow work with a lot of meetings. We move fast, hold clear standards, and expect you to own your tasks. What you get An hourly rate of $20 to $25 USD, based on your experience. Direct mentorship from the founder and a front-row seat to how a marketing agency runs Real room to grow. As we grow, you grow, in both responsibility and pay A long-term home, not a short-term contract How to apply Submit your resume and a short note about yourself, and answer this one question: what is one thing you would most want to get better at in this role, and why?
